data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'pháchos' meaning 'shining' and 'kheir' meaning 'hand'. Fachini represents a loyal fighter or a shining hand. In Christian tradition, it is associated with the faithful disciple Simon Peter who was given the name 'Cephas' meaning 'Rock' by Jesus. The name Fachini carries the meaning “Loyal fighter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fachini usually hope their child will grow to embody loyal fighter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
